accepted.requirement: Exercise the supported caller-supplied 16-byte hash-salt capability on a parser before parsing.
accepted.target_route: After XML_ParserCreate or XML_ParserCreateNS and before XML_Parse, configure that same parser with XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes and a non-NULL 16-byte array; then parse a finite valid document such as <a/>.
accepted.failure_condition: ParseOneInput always calls XML_SetHashSalt with an unsigned-long value. That call sets the upper 64-bit key half to zero and cannot invoke XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes for any input.
accepted.alternative_paths: A zero value passed to the old setter may permit automatic salt generation, but it does not execute the caller-supplied 16-byte setter. Child creation copies the existing key and likewise does not invoke it.

source_evidence.quote:
/* Sets the hash salt to use for internal hash calculations.
   Helps in preventing DoS attacks based on predicting hash function behavior.
   This must be called before parsing is started.
   Returns XML_TRUE if successful, XML_FALSE when called after parsing has
   started or when parser is NULL.
   Added in Expat 2.7.6.
*/
XMLPARSEAPI(XML_Bool)
XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes(XML_Parser parser, const uint8_t entropy[16]);
